motivation: Isolate fitting-source effects and decision-policy effects after observed regressions; previous test results motivated this research and are not independent confirmation.

new_source.name: pwd2021
new_source.published_counts_caveat: Publisher describes 80000 processed cases but 83275 SQL records. Use released numeric labels without inferring removed records; report actual totals and curation.
new_source.collection: historical 2020-2021; Google/Ebbu2017 benign and PhishTank/OpenPhish/PhishRepo phishing
new_source.evidence: publisher source-derived labels; not independent human or Indonesian gold
new_source.sql_handling: parse literal INSERT records as text only; never execute SQL or download HTML

exposure: exclude historical registry, every exposure-sidecar and current v6 caches before new-source partitioning; preserve all new sanitized intake in a new sidecar, including reserved final test
existing_development: reuse only frozen fit/tune/calibration/threshold from v6-expanded-data-20261105; never include its observed new_test or older benchmarks in development
weighting: source_sqrt, normalized mean one; identical recipe for all candidates
calibration: each candidate sigmoid C=1000 on the same separate calibration partition, positive slope required; no test calibration
primary_selection: tune-only macro source recall at empirical 1% FPR per supported source; gate gain>=2pp vs original v6 matched development control and no supported-source recall loss>5pp; stable ties by minimum source recall then AP; if no eligible candidate still report failed gate without promotion
secondary_policies: predeclare pooled benign FPR budgets 0.1%,0.5%,1%,2%; thresholds selected on threshold partition only; all reported, none selected from final tests; pooled budget does not guarantee per-source or test FPR
fit_isolation: refit encoder/classifier separately on each candidate fitting subset; same validation/calibration/threshold composition for all candidates
freeze: bind protocol, code, data, calibration and all policy thresholds before loading final test labels/cores for scoring
limits: no verified Indonesia gold or contemporary two-class temporal holdout
novel domains do not prove independent campaigns
publisher labels and search ranking can be wrong
old benchmarks were observed before this experiment and are regression diagnostics
original frozen v6 runtime/metadata/thresholds stay unchanged
combined artifact inherits noncommercial research restriction
